links.outcome: GPT-4o accuracy and completeness versus residents and infectious disease specialists on same questions
links.effect: True/false accuracy: GPT-4o 87.5%, specialists 90.3%, residents 77.8%. Specialists outperformed GPT-4o on open-ended (p = .008) and case-based (P = .02) accuracy; GPT-4o more complete than residents.
links.quote: In true/false questions, GPT-4o showed comparable accuracy (87.5%) to specialists (90.3%) and exceeded residents (77.8%).

screen.reason: The study empirically assesses the accuracy and completeness of GPT-4o on infectious disease clinical vignettes and questions compared to resident and specialist physicians, but it does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
